To be able to come and stand at this altar where my Mother of God appeared, and to share my testimony, I am deeply grateful to my Blessed Mother and to Jesus.
My name is Diya, and I come from Thammanam in Ernakulam district.
It was during the greatest crisis of my life that I came to know about the Mother of Kreupasanam.
On January 1st, 2025, the dreadful disease of cancer entered my life. I have two little children; one is five years old and the other is three.
I didn't know what to do, as my husband is working abroad. My father is paralyzed on one side and is only just beginning to walk slowly.
We are not a financially sound family, so I had no idea how we would face this. Like anyone would, I asked the doctor,
"Will I be able to live? Will I have a long life? Will my illness be cured?"
The doctor told me, "This cancer is incurable. For six months or a year, you might not have any symptoms, but it will come back, and it will keep coming back."
I didn't know what to do. I dropped my two children at school and told the teacher, "I don't know what to do anymore.
I am entrusting my children to you; you must look after them.
Even if I am not here, please take good care of them. If anything happens, tell my father, and he will come.
I don't know if I will be able to come back anymore," I said, crying. It was at that moment that the LKG teacher, Miss Darly, saw me. The miss called out to me.
What else could I do? Seeing me cry, she asked, "What happened?" I told her, "I have cancer, and I don't know if I will be able to come here anymore."
The miss said, "Will you come with me to Kreupasanam?" She had already taken the Covenant, and she had so much faith in it.
Since I felt like everything was lost and finished, I told her, "I am ready to go anywhere, Miss, I have no problem."
But I added, "Miss, I can't walk at all. My legs are completely swollen. I am breathless, and I cannot even climb a single step. Will I be able to come?"
The miss replied, "I will take you. You just need to come with me." So, I was getting ready to leave with the miss.
My legs were so swollen that I couldn't even wear my footwear. "Miss, I cannot step down, my legs are swollen, and I cannot walk."
I ended up wearing my mother's slippers and came. We traveled by bus, and I sat with my legs hanging down.
I knew that when we arrived, the swelling would increase, and I wouldn't be able to step down. The miss said, "I will hold you and help you down; we can go sit inside."
So, Miss Darly brought me inside the church near the altar and made me sit down. When I sat and stretched out my legs, the swelling was completely gone! I was in absolute shock.
I had only just set foot here, where did the swelling go? It was the time the swelling usually increases, but there was none.
Oh, my Mother! An instant remedy, an instant miracle! I couldn't believe it at all.
I told her, "Miss, the swelling on my legs is gone, and I don't know where it went. I don't even know what to say!"
Then the miss said, "Those taking the Covenant for the first time must go to the second floor." I said, "I don't know if I can climb, Miss.
Even climbing one floor makes me breathless, so I don't know if I can climb two floors." The miss assured me, "I will take you up slowly; we can take breaks and climb."
I honestly don't know how I climbed those two floors. I didn't stop anywhere; I climbed the two floors in one go.
Even after reaching the top, I wasn't breathless or struggling at all. The miss was gasping for air, but I felt absolutely fine.
"Miss, I have no problem, I practically ran up those two floors, and I feel nothing." I didn't know the Blessed Mother could perform miracles so swiftly!
After taking the Covenant, I returned home. Once home, I didn't know what to do with the Covenant medal.
I just pinned it to my dress and went to sleep. When I woke up in the morning, took a bath and changed, I forgot to put the medal back on.
Suddenly, I heard a terrible noise in the room, like a mixer grinder running. "Who is using a mixer this early in the morning?"
I opened the windows and looked, went downstairs and checked, but no one was there. Yet, that sound kept piercing my ears.
Then I suddenly looked and saw the medal lying on the floor with my old clothes. I realized I had forgotten it.
I immediately picked it up and pinned it on, and the very next second, the noise stopped. Then I understood that it was the Blessed Mother reminding me, and that was why the sound came.
That day passed. The next day, I told the Mother, "Mother, I don't have the habit of waking up early in the morning. Anyway, please wake me up at 5:30 AM."
Saying this, I went to sleep. The next morning, I heard a voice: "Diya, wake up! Come on, wake up, isn't it time for prayer?"
It was my mother's voice, my very own mamma's voice that I heard. I jumped out of bed, but I couldn't see my mamma anywhere.
I went downstairs to look, and my mamma was there, sound asleep. So I thought, "Okay, mamma must have called me and then gone back to sleep."
I said my prayers, and after everything was done, I went downstairs and asked her, "Mamma, did you wake me up and then run back to bed?"
She said, "No, I didn't. I didn't even come to your room to wake you."
That's when I realized that the voice I heard was the Blessed Mother's! "Oh Mother, was it You who came to wake me up?"
Ever since then, I have never taken the Covenant medal off my person. I have never missed my prayers even for a single day.
Eventually, the date for my transplant arrived. I entrusted my little children to my Blessed Mother.
"Mother, I must return. I want to live with my children; my desire to live is not yet fulfilled, Mother," I prayed as I left for the transplant.
I had no money in hand and didn't know what to do. "Will I have to sell my wedding chain, Mother?" I cried.
I went to the hospital and got admitted. Once everything started, I didn't even know where the money was coming from.
Every time they asked me to pay a certain amount, lakhs of rupees kept pouring into my account.
Unknown people kept depositing money, and my account was constantly being filled.
Many people gave cash in hand, and even the hospital helped. The room I was admitted to was a sterile one where nothing from outside was allowed.
In that room, I said, "I need to bring in my Mother's picture and the blessed salt. That is all I need to bring inside.
Even if I have nothing else, it's not a problem." So, I kept the picture of the Blessed Mother and the blessed salt in that room.
There came a moment when I couldn't speak, and I couldn't even swallow a drop of water.
The friend who was staying with me would play the Mother's 5 AM 'Daily Bread' reflections for me every day. I would listen to it, but I couldn't eat any food.
Then I rinsed my mouth with the water mixed with the Mother's blessed salt.
The doctor had said, "If she continues like this without eating, the chances of recovery are very low. She won't recover quickly. She needs to eat food, otherwise, she will become even more tired."
After using the Mother's blessed salt water to rinse my mouth for two days, on the third day, I started eating food.
The doctor said, "Now she has a chance of survival. She will recover quickly now, it's fine. Thank God she has started eating."
Giving immense praise to the Blessed Mother, I finally returned home. But when I reached home, there was no one with me.
I was completely alone in a room. I couldn't see my children, and I couldn't see my family. I was locked inside that room.
"Oh my Mother, I am unable to sleep. I just want to sleep peacefully for at least one day, Mother.
I cannot bear this pain anymore. Mother, please be with me," I prayed.
That night, when I slowly opened my eyes, near my door, I saw this very Mother—the Mother in the grey mantle—standing there.
I thought it might be a reflection of light from the window, or maybe the curtains were moved. I checked, but the curtains were perfectly in place.
The Mother was standing right there! I blinked my eyes and looked again to confirm if it was really the Mother.
It was Her! I realized, "The Mother is truly with me! So, I don't need to fear anymore. She will take care of my children; I have no fear."
That day, I slept so peacefully. Today, all my medical test results are negative.
Until now, I haven't had a single test come back positive. Every time I go for a test, I apply the anointing oil in the sign of the cross and recite the Apostles' Creed.
I am a non-Christian. I didn't know the Apostles' Creed, the Holy Rosary, or anything else. I didn't know the Holy Bible.
When I came here that day, the miss bought a book of the Holy Rosary for me. Till this day, I pray the Holy Rosary every single day without fail. I read the Holy Bible for half an hour daily.
At first, when I read the Bible, I couldn't understand anything. Then, I downloaded an app called the online POC Bible and started listening to it.
By listening and reading along, I have now finished reading the New Testament twice.
I was able to grow much closer to Jesus. Thus, all my tests are now negative, and that is my first testimony.
I received the grace of always having my Mother with me. My second testimony is this: I had taken a three-month leave from my office.
I work at Infopark. Three months turned into four months, and by the fourth month, it seemed certain that I would lose my job.
"I cannot survive without my job, Mother. I absolutely need this job, Mother. I have to take care of my children," I cried.
Kneeling down, I recited the Apostles' Creed and fervently prayed the intercessory prayers of the Blessed Mother.
Right then, I received a call from the office: "Diya, if you bring a medical fitness certificate, you can rejoin. It's not a problem, we have discussed it."
Giving immense praise to the Blessed Mother, I rejoined my job. Now, whatever problems anyone faces there, they all come running to me.
"Diya, please mention this to the Mother. Please place our petitions before Her," they say.
The Blessed Mother is fulfilling everything I pray for. Today, everyone in my office has immense faith in the Blessed Mother.
They will all come here to take the Covenant, and they have asked me to share the testimonies they received.
That is my second testimony. Now, regarding my acts of mercy... At first, as an act of mercy,
when packing rice daily, I used to take one extra meal packet and give it to everyone. But then I felt that it wasn't enough.
With every Covenant renewal, I felt deep down that it just wasn't enough. Now, I didn't know how to cook food in bulk.
Even so, once a month now, I pack meals for around 25 people.
Along with the packed meals, I buy bedsheets, dhotis, shirts, and nighties,
and I started walking around distributing them to people sitting on the streets. In this way, I began delivering food to many people.
Then, I visit an old age home in Kalamassery. I cook and provide all their meals for an entire day,
doing everything for them. Like this, I am doing whatever acts of mercy I can. For those without money,
who post online and everywhere asking for medical help, I transfer whatever amount I can and give it to them.
Every month, I come here without fail and buy the newsletters. I started walking around and distributing all those newsletters, sharing the testimony of my blessing.
I visit the cancer wards and tell them, "You do not need to fear anything. If Mother Mary saved me,
She will save you too." Telling them this, I started handing them out. I will deliver the newspapers to everyone. The place I visit once,
I don't go there again. I deliver the newsletters to people who do not know about this, who do not know about Kreupasanam.
Now, I mostly give Hindi newspapers because there are more Hindi speakers in my office. Therefore, I buy all Hindi newspapers.
Then, I watch the Daily Bread every day without fail. The retreat without fail...
If I cannot attend the retreat at the exact time Father is conducting it, I make sure to attend it afterward, without fail.
I started doing that. Also, with testimonies. In the past, whenever I traveled somewhere, I used to go with earphones in both ears, listening to songs.
Now, I don't listen to secular songs. Instead, I listen to testimonies. Daily, I listen to six or seven testimonies.
When I hear a testimony that seems relevant to someone, whosever face comes to my memory, I share it with them.
Like this, I share testimonies every single day. I know that an illness like cancer might be cured through medical treatment.
But greater than all of that is having courage. That means, the moment we are told we have cancer,
we feel like we are finished, that we will just die, and that there is no escape for us. But the courage to face it was given to me by my Mother Mary.
How? By showing me that Mother Mary is with me every single moment. When I thought my life was completely over,
and I had absolutely no one—even in that moment when I felt finished, Mother Mary gave me the courage to face it. My Jesus is with me.
My Mother is with me. Now, I am not afraid to live. For me, my children, and everyone, my Mother Mary gave me back to them.
So, thank you so, so much for the immense blessing Mother Mary has given me. Now, my earnest desire is to remain in the Covenant until the very end of my life.
A lot, a lot, a lot of thanks to Mother Mary and my Jesus.
"Behold, I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and will bring you back to this land; for I will not leave you until I have done that of which I have spoken to you."
This is the Book of Genesis, Chapter 28, Verse 15: "I am with you and will keep you wherever you go."
Everywhere, on every path we take, God is always with us.
In the testimonies of the Covenant children, what we repeatedly hear is that the Blessed Mother, Mother of Kreupasanam,
is a Mother who abides with us. Kreupasanam is a place where we profoundly experience the presence of God.
Everyone who arrives here deeply experiences God's presence. A person does not return in the same condition she came in.
The Mother wipes the tears of each and every person who comes weeping, and She sends them back full of joy.
In the testimony of the daughter named Diya Sivadasan, it was with an illness called bone marrow cancer that Diya Sivadasan first arrived in the presence of the Blessed Mother.
After entrusting her own children to the hands of their teachers, when she went to see the teachers with tears in her eyes as she was leaving for her medical treatment,
a teacher sitting nearby overheard this and immediately brought this daughter to Kreupasanam.
It was a time of intense suffering. Her entire leg was swollen and she was in agony.
Enduring unbearable pain, somehow she managed to travel from Ernakulam to reach here.
She came here and sat in this holy shrine where the Blessed Mother appeared alive,
and very quickly, in that very moment itself, that daughter's leg ailment was miraculously healed.
The pain in her leg vanished, and later she was able to climb all those steps to take the Covenant.
Usually, when cancer patients hear the word cancer, it strikes terror in all of us. But here,
coming into the presence of the Blessed Mother, even though she came with agonizing difficulty, the Mother was filling her with courage. The Mother is declaring,
"I am with you. I will keep you wherever you go." This is a divine promise for the Covenant children.
Diya Sivadasan stood firm in that promise, believed, and prayed. As a result,
in every matter that followed, this daughter was able to vividly experience God's intervention, God's care, and God's protection.
The medical treatments and everything proceeded very smoothly. But the expenses for the treatment...
it was highly, highly miraculous. The funds came in a way that was completely beyond imagination because,
when it came to the treatment, while she was sitting in absolute dread over whether she would lose even her sacred wedding chain (Thali mala), from where she didn't know,
or how she didn't know, but hundreds of thousands of rupees suddenly appeared in her account.
She was able to undergo the treatment immediately. Jesus and the Blessed Mother blessed her, returning her to her own home,
with her own children and husband, granting her a beautiful new life. Coming to the shrine of the Blessed Mother,
the Mother never lets those who intercede with tears leave without wiping away their weeping. This daughter's experience was exactly like that.
In the moment she felt completely abandoned with no one by her side, she was able to perceive the presence of the Blessed Mother in manifold ways. It was the Mother's presence,
the profound presence of the Mother, that this daughter was able to see very clearly and distinctly. When she was weeping and agonizing over her own children,
the Mother Herself appeared, and seeing the Mother right there in Her presence,
She told her, "Daughter, do not fear, I am with you." Later, regarding her employment as well, the job she had lost was restored to her as a fruit of her prayers to the Mother.
Here too, we witness a mighty intervention of the Blessed Mother and Jesus in this daughter's life.
In our lives as well, the deep comfort that we are never alone is what we receive when we abide in the Covenant life.
